what: ark.photo.fromParent / fromGrandparent / fromGreatGrandparent (the line beside an ancestor's photo on the tap card; docs/ark/CAPTURE-MEDIA-CONTRACT.md 2.6)
reference: en (written by hand); not reviewed by a native speaker
review_notes: Meaning: 'Photo of its parent / grandparent / great-grandparent, brought aboard by {name}'.
The Ark records no sex, so no language says mother or father; where a language must choose a gender for the parent animal it uses the masculine/default form.
{name} is the ancestor's @username (linked on the card).
